Randall Carlson joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 501, an early brick in the wall of his lost-civilization case. Carlson teaches that cosmic impacts, not slow change alone, drove key turns in Earth's past. His talks mix field geology with myth from around the world.

He walks Rogan through the evidence he trusts: flood layers, melted ground, and stories that sound like reports of disaster from the sky. Rogan asks how mainstream geology answers him. The episode pairs well with his episode 606 visit, and together they show the case being built in public, one long talk at a time.
